canonical_project: Longteng Liangshan AI Data Center (珑腾凉山州AI数据中心)
owner: Longteng Data / project company in Yanyuan County
notes: Final pre-operation construction push in Yanyuan County: RMB35bn total investment, 150MW total IT capacity; phase 1 RMB8bn (D01 data center + 220kV substation, 2,500 server + 500 network cabinets, 30MW IT load, 40,000P); phase 2 adds 120MW IT load and 160,000P.
